incidents.name: Service Disruption Due to Cloudflare Outage

incident_updates.body:
Resolved:
Following investigation and continued monitoring, we have confirmed that our platform has not been impacted by the broader Cloudflare service disruption. Platform services have remained available and are operating normally.

Customer Impact: 
No impact identified. Platform services remain fully operational.
Reference: Cloudflare Status Page — https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/

We are currently investigating an issue impacting access to our platforms. A broader Cloudflare service disruption is affecting connectivity, resulting in:

Request timeouts
Increased latency and slow page loads
Cloudflare-generated error pages (including 5xx errors)
Intermittent access to platform services

Our teams are actively monitoring the situation and assessing the impact on our services. While the issue appears to originate from Cloudflare's infrastructure, we continue to monitor service health and will provide updates as additional information becomes available.
Customers can monitor Cloudflare's incident status directly at: https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/
Start Time: ~9:35 EDT
We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience while service providers work to restore normal operations.

Customer Impact: Users may experience intermittent access issues, delayed responses, request failures, or Cloudflare error pages when accessing platform services.
Reference: Cloudflare Status Page — https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/

components.name: AI Interview Companion
components.description: The AI Interview Companion status page provides real-time updates on the availability and performance of this AI-powered interview intelligence platform. AI Interview Companion streamlines the hiring process with features like AI transcription, smart summaries, structured interview guides, and candidate skill comparisons. It also supports team-wide feedback sharing, interviewer coaching, and multi-stage question recommendations to enhance interview quality and consistency. Check this page for the latest system status and ensure your team can continue making informed, efficient hiring decisions.

incidents.name: AI Interview Companion Recordings Unavailable Due to Third‑Party Outage

incident_updates.body:
Summary:
We experienced an incident where interview recordings were unavailable due to an outage with a third‑party service used to join and record interviews.

Impact:
Some scheduled interviews were not recorded. As a result, recording playback and downloads for those interviews are unavailable.

Affected Service:
Interview Recording (AI Interview Companion Interviews)

Timeline:
Start: 3/24 at approximately 10 am EDT
End: Approximately 2 hours and 42 minutes later

incidents.name: Degraded Performance - AI Interview Companion Interview API

incident_updates.body:
Summary:
We experienced elevated error rates on the AIIC API due to resource exhaustion on a dependent cache service. This resulted in intermittent request failures for interview scheduling and retrieval.

Impact:
Some customers received error responses or experienced latency when interacting with the AIIC API, leading to failed or degraded interview scheduling and retrieval.

Affected Service:
AI Interview Companion Interview API

Timeline:
Start: 8:27 am EDT
End: 9:30 am EDT

The issue has now been fully resolved, and normal email delivery has resumed.
Any emails impacted during the disruption will be automatically reprocessed and delivered within the next 24 hours. No action is required from customers at this time.
If you continue to experience any issues, please contact Employ Support.

Pillar is currently experiencing an issue with delivery of emails including candidate consent emails due to a third-party email service disruption. Interviews may proceed, but consent emails may be delayed. We are actively working with the provider to restore service
